note: The Hill Campground (The Hill at Soaring Eagle), run by the Saginaw Chippewa tribe's Migizi EDC at 7525 E Tomah Rd, Mt. Pleasant: rustic, shaded modern and tent sites about a mile from Soaring Eagle Casino and two miles from the Soaring Eagle Waterpark; pool with no lifeguard; 24-hr shuttle to the casino. Distinct from Soaring Eagle Hideaway. --Claude
summary: The tribe's campground page now redirects to thehillcampground.com: 2025 rates $40 weekday / $47 weekend RV sites with electric and water ($50 concert nights/holidays; monthly $1,080), tent sites too, dump/fill station by the camp store, booking on Campspot (closed for the season now; 2027 not on sale). Open to the public by the night. Not stated by the operator: amperage (50), site count 46, max rig 65 ft, pull-throughs, showers/laundry, FCFS (all note prose, left). Note: 'RVs/campers only (no tents)' is wrong (tent sites are sold) and the address is 7525, not 7529; field text dropped. No gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 105 km); base $40 is under the gate. Monthly rates exist but nightly is the main product, so no long-stay concern.
